title: Save the Child
description: Elin's in the ruin, and she didn't get there in chains - she followed the lights on her own two feet, same as she told the hamlet she would if anyone had listened. Whatever she was promised, the cult leader isn't in a hurry to let her walk back out. Break the ones holding the door and get her free.

objectives.description: Kill the cultists guarding the ruin
Kill the cult leader before he decides Elin isn't leaving

notes: Turn (per REWRITE_SPEC): Elin followed the cult on her own; the hamlet's assumption of abduction is wrong. She still needs rescuing once the cult won't let her leave. No bible basis - local colour.
